description_en: Retrieves the enablement status of the control policy
description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus查询管控策略功能的开启或关闭状态
name: GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus

parameters.help_en: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略 默认值为：CONTROL_POLICY
parameters.help_zh: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略 默认值为：CONTROL_POLICY
parameters.name: control_policy_type

ControlPolicyType.title_en: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略
ControlPolicyType.title_zh: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略

EnablementStatus.description_en:
The enablement status of the control policy. Valid values:

Enabled: The control policy is enabled.

PendingEnable: The control policy is being enabled.

Disabled: The control policy is disabled.

PendingDisable: The control policy is being disabled
EnablementStatus.description_zh:
管控策略状态。取值：

Enabled：已开启。
PendingEnable：开启中。
Disabled：已关闭。
PendingDisable：关闭中
